clusters.headline: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin Resigns Amid AI Cheating Scandal
aiSummaryBullets: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin stepped down on Sunday following widespread concerns regarding AI-assisted cheating in national assessments.
The resignation follows a confession from a top-scoring candidate on a national tax accountant exam who admitted to utilizing AI technology.

clusters.headline: Six Injured After Bus Crashes Near Hongik University Station
aiSummaryBullets: A bus hit a sidewalk in Seoul's Hongik University area on Saturday.
The incident occurred after a collision involving another bus and a car.

clusters.headline: South Korean Democratic Party Seeks Impeachment Of Chief Justice
aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party aims to initiate an impeachment motion against the Supreme Court chief justice on December 3.
The planned action follows the Supreme Court's decision to order a retrial for former Prime Minister Han regarding his martial law role.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Visits AI Data Center Project In Ulsan
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung visited an artificial intelligence data center currently under construction in the city of Ulsan.
The president emphasized the importance of rapid development to maintain competitiveness within the global artificial intelligence industry.

clusters.headline: Democratic Party Plans Impeachment Vote Against Chief Justice Jo
aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party of Korea has formally decided to pursue an impeachment motion against Chief Justice Jo Hee-de.
A vote on the motion is currently being targeted for completion by the end of this calendar year.

clusters.headline: Samsung And SK Hynix Shares Plummet Amid Global Tech Market Slump
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares recorded significant losses during Friday trading on the Korea Exchange.
The decline follows a broader Wall Street technology sell-off and investor apprehension regarding the sustainability of the AI market.

clusters.headline: BTS Secures Five Awards At The 2026 MAMA Ceremony In Osaka
aiSummaryBullets: BTS received five awards at the 2026 MAMA ceremony in Osaka.
The awards event spanned two days at the Kyocera Dome Osaka.

clusters.headline: Freight Train Derails Near Sejong Causing Rail Service Suspension
aiSummaryBullets: Five freight train cars went off the tracks near Sejong early Saturday after an emergency braking system engaged.
No injuries were reported as a result of the derailment involving the 21-car train.

clusters.headline: Seoul Shares Plummet Amid Growing Concerns Over AI Infrastructure
aiSummaryBullets: The Korea Composite Stock Price Index dropped 5.21 percent to close at 4,869.96 following a sharp decline.
The market slump was driven by losses in technology stocks amid ongoing uncertainty over the profitability of AI infrastructure investments.

clusters.headline: Trump Discusses Korean Peninsula Risks In Summit With Xi And Putin
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump reported discussing Korean Peninsula security challenges with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
The trilateral meeting took place this week, with initial reports highlighting a primary focus on nuclear arms reduction and broader dialogue.

clusters.headline: K-Pop Groups BIGBANG And Kiss Of Life Announce New Music Releases
aiSummaryBullets: The K-pop boy group BIGBANG officially released their new digital single titled GiiiRIP.
Girl group Kiss of Life unveiled teaser photos for their first winter-themed single, Greedy.

clusters.headline: First Lady Kim Hea Kyung Promotes Global Recognition For Kimchi
aiSummaryBullets: First lady Kim Hea Kyung attended a ceremony and event in Seoul to mark the seventh annual Kimchi Day.
During the fair, the first lady viewed exhibits of award-winning cabbage and radish varieties used for the traditional side dish.

clusters.headline: Kiwoom Heroes Trade Captain Ahead Of Upcoming KBO Awards Ceremony
aiSummaryBullets: The Kiwoom Heroes baseball club confirmed the trade of their team captain.
The Korea Baseball Organization scheduled its annual awards ceremony for November 26 in Seoul.

clusters.headline: President Lee Jae Myung Appoints Kim Jong-chul As Police Chief
aiSummaryBullets: President Lee Jae Myung officially appointed Kim Jong-chul as the new commissioner general of the Korean National Police Agency.
The appointment followed the successful adoption of a confirmation hearing report by a parliamentary committee with support from both major parties.

clusters.headline: Seoul High Court Upholds Acquittal Of Kakao Founder Kim Beom-Su
aiSummaryBullets: The Seoul High Court confirmed the acquittal of Kakao founder Kim Beom-su on charges of stock price manipulation.
Prosecutors alleged Kim manipulated SM Entertainment share prices to win a takeover battle against Hybe in 2023.

clusters.headline: South Korean National Assembly Passes Pro-Democracy Activist Bill
aiSummaryBullets: The National Assembly approved a bill granting state recognition to pro-democracy activists.
The legislation passed following a vote to end an extended filibuster by the People Power Party.

clusters.headline: Samsung Lions Claim First Korean Series Championship In Twelve Years
aiSummaryBullets: The Samsung Lions defeated the Wiz to secure their first Korean Series championship since 2014.
Captain Koo Ja-wook was named the series MVP after competing despite a physical injury.

clusters.headline: Son Heung-min Addresses Internal Divisions Within South Korean Team
aiSummaryBullets: Captain Son Heung-min stated that recent internal player conflicts within the South Korean national football team have been resolved.
The statement followed public reports of a dressing room rift following the team's early exit from the World Cup.

clusters.headline: South Korea To Deploy Additional Naval Assets To Hormuz Region
aiSummaryBullets: South Korea is broadening its existing anti-piracy maritime operations in the Middle East.
The expansion includes the deployment of additional naval assets and specialized demining capabilities.

clusters.headline: Samsung And Google Initiate Preorders For New Smart Glasses Model
aiSummaryBullets: Samsung and Google are launching a new wearable device featuring integrated artificial intelligence technology.
The companies scheduled the start of customer preorders for the upcoming smart glasses for Thursday.
